text:
Sam G: Quick kickoff: we need a compact runbook for the tenant routing cutover next Thu. Key asks: per-tenant instant-off, A/B not on enterprise, clear go/no-go, automated aborts.
Marta L: I sketched a minimal plan: internal smoke -> partner beta (opt-in) -> gradual roll (slices). Include a 0% safe-holdback cohort for enterprise.
Indra K: Important: during partner beta we run a shadow duplicate to the new routing and compare outputs. If quality delta > 1.2% for billing prompts we pause.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: proposed window: 2026-04-08 03:30 UTC. Auto-abort if service_error_rate >= 2.5% OR p95_latency_increase >= 40ms for 10m.
Priya S: CS request: need console toggle and API to flip a tenant immediately. Also legal wants logs retained for 7 days for audited tenants.
Sam G: Scope note: only routing decision layer changes. No downstream schema or contract changes. Ops must have CLI + console paths to toggle.
Marta L: Runbook outline (compact):
- Preflight: smoke tests, dashboard links, tenant list for partner beta
- Phase A: internal (1% internal) smoke, min 5m
- Phase B: partner beta (opt-in tenants, ~3-7 tenants), shadow + 15m window or 1000 samples
- Phase C: gradual ramp (10% -> 40% -> 100% by slices) with 30m hold at each step
- Emergency: soft-kill command -> `routing override --to m-small --reason "cutover-fallback"`
- Rollback: `/ops rollback routing_v2` + CS notify list

Indra K: Metrics to gate on: service_error_rate_pct, p95_latency_ms, quality_regression_pct (eval harness), token_cost_delta_pct. Abort if any exceed thresholds for sustained 10m.
deploy-bot: Canary config suggestion: sample_target_per_phase=1500 OR min_time=15m. Add cost monitor: alert if token_cost_delta_pct > 8%.
Priya S: Communications: prep short email + console banner for partner beta tenants. Include opt-out steps: 1) console toggle, 2) CS can flip for tenant via internal UI, 3) 24h rollback SLA promise for enterprise paying customers.
Sam G: Ownership: Marta owner for runbook and infra flag; Indra owns evals and shadow jobs; SRE owns alerting and abort automation; Priya owns customer comms + CS ops.
Marta L: I'll open infra PR for flag `routing_v2_tenant` and include per-tenant `force_off` API. PR will link to runbook.
Indra K: We'll use two prompt suites for quality checks: `billing-critical-v2` and `auth-flows`. If diff_rate > 1.2% we alert ML reviewers. We'll post diffs to #eng-ml-review.
CS-Pete: I'll collect partner beta consenting tenants and verify they have staging keys. Also will run opt-out verification during partner beta.
deploy-bot: Guardrails to implement in CI: abort_conditions = ["service_error_rate_pct>=2.5","p95_latency_ms_delta>=40","quality_regression_pct>=1.2"], retention_policy=7d for logs.
Sam G: Two decisions for Wednesday: final numeric thresholds and who is authorized to hit the rollback (name). Also confirm whether we allow small manual rollforward after rollback within same window.
Marta L: Suggest decision: Marta or oncall-sre can authorize rollback. Manual rollforward after rollback requires meeting notes and sign-off.
Priya S: I'll draft the partner email and console copy. CS-Pete & I will do opt-out test matrix in staging Tue.
Indra K: I'll wire the shadow comparator and prepare the automated diff report (daily digest + immediate alert on threshold).
Marta L: Posting runbook link here once PR merges: https://infra/repo/pull/6789 (WIP).
Sam G: Okay, schedule runbook walkthrough Thu 11:00 UTC. Keep comments here short; post links as they land. :thumbsup:
